record: Adjudication of QC_R1 findings (PE-MASTER, 2026-10-19). Packages NOT modified (QC_R1 hashes pin them); corrections recorded here and supersede package text where stated.

adjudications.correction: P03 REPORT PATH-NULL-B is corrected: when byte [EDI+0x38]==0 OR the 00822970 fallback returns AL==0, control enters the LOOP path @00823CB5 - it does NOT reach XOR EAX,EAX. XOR EAX,EAX @00823CAE is reached only from the flag-set + fallback-true path. The loop path may still return 0 (00823DFF) or an object. Return-path taxonomy corrected: FAST / LOOP / NULL-A([EDI+0x24]==0) / NULL-CAE(flag+fallback) / NULL-DFF(loop exhausted or resolver null-abort @00823D2A->00823DBF->00823DFF).

P03 claim P03-K08 downgraded CONFIRMED->STRONGLY_SUPPORTED: 'object pointer' is KIND-BY-USE with the unproven premise that unopened 00826760/00826840 consume ECX as this (thiscall). Correspondingly the FLOW.md statement upgrading P02 GLOBAL_ELEMENT_KIND to OBJECT_POINTER_OR_ZERO is re-labeled: GLOBAL_ELEMENT_KIND = OBJECT_POINTER_OR_ZERO @ STRONGLY_SUPPORTED (kind-by-use premise), NOT CONFIRMED. No CONFIRMED pointer/handle/id distinction.

P03 REPORT section 7 target list corrected: the intra-window jump targets are 00823c69,c6c,cae,cb5,d00,d13,da2,db3,dbf,dce,dff,e03,e11,e27,e44 (15 targets; the phantom '00823df' removed, missing '00823dce' added). QC's programmatic census: 21 jump instructions / 16 unique targets, ALL in-window - containment stands.
vtable+0x3C call args: (ESI, M32[ESP+0x24]) - PUSH EAX then PUSH ESI makes ESI the first stack arg.
004D1430 stack args: arg1=&local (EDX), arg2=&arg1-slot (ECX) (PUSH ECX then PUSH EDX).
FS-restore load MOV ECX,[ESP+0x48] @00823E31; FS:[0] write @00823E44.

P04 claim P04-K05 re-labeled: the three FLDZ-sourced zero stores write to the CALLER'S OWN out-arg out2[0..0xC] (ESI=M32[ESP+0x64]=out2 arg slot), NOT to the translation of the copied transform. 'builds a rotation-only transform' was a STRUCTURE->SEMANTICS promotion; corrected claim: 0085C0F0 copies the 9-dword rotation to a local, writes a zero 3-vector to its out-arg, and calls 0096CD10(this=&local, ESI=out2) - semantics of 0096CD10 UNKNOWN (unopened).

P04 STACK_MAP corrected: the ESP balance of 0085BFA0 DOES require the virtual slot+0x24 callee to be callee-clean (RET 4) and 0096CB20 to clean 0x24 (created by SUB ESP,0x24 @0085BFBD); the earlier 'callee-clean assumption NOT needed' phrasing is superseded. QC's independent buffer-coherence check (ESP0-0x54) confirms the balance.
The [ESP..]-area rebuild is a 9-float gather preserving order (translation components bypass 0096CB20 and are written directly to the out transform).
padding dwords between named stack slots were not enumerated; no load-bearing impact (no claims depended on them).
P02 REPORT section 7 slot references are +4 from the stated ones where they refer to post-push offsets; package text stands corrected by QC_R1 REPORT; no claim status change.
B08 evidence form: census statement retained as worker-formulated; QC_R1 re-derived the value-interpretation census from raw rows - conclusion unchanged (no in-window deref of element values).
